Amira (Partnerships): quick ping 11 - Orchestrator vendor (OrchFlow) wants a marketplace bundle: their orchestrator + our gateway + LangChain connector. They asked for guidance on API keys vs OIDC for connector auth and a 20-minute sandbox run. cc @Noah @Sanjay

Noah (Eng): short answer: connector registration supports API keys (scoped) and OIDC client creds. for running connectors we prefer short-lived API keys with `connector_scope` for least privilege.

Sanjay (Infra): infra notes: marketplace bundles must include a `key_policy.json` describing rotation and TTL. we can auto-rotate connector keys every 24h for sandbox; production default 7d.

Leah (Solutions): OrchFlow specifically asked for a token-exchange flow so their runner can swap a connector API key for a short-lived runtime token. we can support an endpoint `/api/v1/token/exchange` that mints runtime tokens scoped to job_id.

Noah (Eng): suggested minimal curl for exchange (for quickstart):

```
# exchange connector API key for runtime token
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/token/exchange \
  -H "Authorization: ApiKey $CONNECTOR_KEY" \
  -d '{"job_id":"demo-123","ttl":300}'
```

Noah (Eng): response will include `runtime_token` and `expires_at`. we'll document that.

Sanjay (Infra): permission mapping: connector keys -> scope: [register, post_job, status]; runtime_token -> scope: [post_inference]. I'll draft `key_policy.json` template. ETA 2d.

Amira (Partnerships): timeline: can we get a one-page quickstart + exchange curl + key_policy by EOD Wed? partner wants sandbox Thurs. marketing-bot: need blurb for marketplace.

marketing-bot: calendar: sandbox slot tentatively booked for 2025-05-08 11:00 PT. Please confirm.

Leah (Solutions): I'll add a smoke-test that 1) registers connector, 2) exchanges key, 3) posts a job, 4) validates callback. include malformed-key test to show 401 behavior.

Noah (Eng): will open PR with quickstart and smoke-test. keeping examples minimal.

Sanjay (Infra): will produce `key_policy.json` and tenant tagging changes.

Amira (Partnerships): perfect 11 I'll confirm sandbox with OrchFlow once PR lands. thanks team!
